verdict.rationale: Databricks documents registering external MCP servers alongside built-in system.ai MCP Services and custom MCP servers. Agents can then discover, authenticate to, and call these servers' tools with governed access. The Marketplace also lists MCP servers that customers can connect to from their workspace. missing for 10: evidence that the built-in Genie Code assistant itself can use plugged-in MCP servers (documented consumption is via agent code you deploy), detailed registration/configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
